text:
maria: Quick proposal — run a small SLA experiment for inbound leads this week. Idea: split 10% of traffic into a 'fast handoff' path that skips enrichment and claims via rr immediately, 90% stays current path. Goal: measure MQL->SQL conversion delta and claim latency impact. thoughts?

aj: quick q — do we have safe fallback if HS enrichment fails? last time we had deadlocks.

maria: yes, fallback = immediate claim + tag `enrichment-pending`. SF sync will backfill enrich on claim. plan to monitor queue depth + claim success.

samir: sounds good. what metrics to track?

maria: primary: claim latency (ms), owner assignment success %, leads that get dropped, 7-day SQL conversion. secondary: time-to-first-touch.

olivia: +1. Add observability: heartbeat on enrichment job and a metric for 'enrichment pending count'.

jess: can we do canary on timezone-sensitive queues? weekend cover previously exploded.

maria: good catch. will exclude weekend cohort and APAC overnight 00:00-06:00 PT for now.

hubspot-bot: Workflow "Fast Handoff - 10pct" created by maria at 2026-03-21 10:12 UTC

aj: config snippet?

maria: 
```
workflow: Fast Handoff - 10pct
trigger: contact.created
criteria: contact.lead_source == 'inbound' && rand() < 0.1
actions:
  - enqueue: handoff_fast_queue
  - set_property: enrichment_status = 'skipped_for_experiment'
```

samir: will need a matching SF rule: if enrichment_status == skipped_for_experiment then set OwnerType = 'auto-claim' and bypass lead assignment rules. I'll draft SF rule.

olivia: ops runbook? short bullets fine.

maria: Runbook (short): 
- monitor enrichment_pending_count > 500 -> pause experiment
- claim_failure_rate > 2% for 5min -> rollback
- SQL conversion delta negative & significant p<0.05 after 7 days -> rollback
- escalation: page @aj @samir

jess: timeline?

maria: start canary Mon 03/23 09:00 PT for 48h, expand if stable.

aj: I'll add dashboards and alerts.

samir: I'll push SF mapping tonight and share change set.

olivia: tagging: #marketing #ops. I'm good with exclusion windows.

maria: cool — action items: aj (dash+alerts), samir (SF rule), jess (claims weekend runbook check), olivia (observability). I'll kick off HS workflow now. We'll reconvene Tue 03/25 11:00 PT for post-canary review. :rocket:

jess: :thumbsup:

samir: :eyes:
